firstError.message: original Windows coordination context/file/rollback lock unconfirmed

cause: The positive test repeatedly passed a freshly computed end()=now+10 instead of the originally captured lease deadline. Production correctly refused this extension.
fix: Bind one original deadline in the positive test and use it unchanged for acquire/check/release. Keep the no-extension production assertion and competitor/byte/ID/8projection assertions.
extraReview: Any failed lease/context recheck must poison further callbacks until own kernel locks unwind; add explicit post-refusal recheck test. Retain actual locks on failure/expiry until scoped release, never claim failed operation succeeded.
